example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা একটা লালমুখো, সবসময় ঝামেলা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is being naughty like a red-faced monkey.
The kid is a real impish monkey, always causing trouble.
note: Refers to the red-faced appearance of common monkeys in Bengal, used affectionately or teasingly for mischievous behavior.
